tasks.short: Explain a regulatory change to other departments.

steps.what: Open the regulatory information already decided.
Draft the note so departments can read the information.

loop.check: every sentence cites the decided rule
loop.stop: stop when a sentence adds a new duty
loop.why_not_simpler: departments misread a raw rule, and a fixed template cannot see the decided scope

steps.what: Check the note is interpreted as the manager decided.
Send the signed regulatory information to the departments.

tasks.design: Only a rule the manager has already decided is opened from {DOCS}. The draft may cite that decision and may not add a duty. The regulatory affairs manager checks the interpretation, then the {EMAIL} send uses the signed note. A rule with no decision is not sent.
tasks.previous_blocker: The gazette text was forwarded raw, and two departments acted on two readings.
tasks.enabler_now: A decision that already exists can be the only source of the note.
tasks.still_hard: A department that hears a duty the decision did not state.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can hear that a plain sentence will be read as a new ban.
tasks.altitude: Communication waits on the manager's reading of the note. The decision was already made. The send does not create a new interpretation.

reach.task: Circulate a decided control and stop a sentence that adds a duty.
reach.learn: The citation check is shared. The interpretation check stays here.

evidence.claim: A note can be limited to a decision already recorded. It cannot decide what a rule means.

A drafted sentence may cite only a rule or a figure already in the file. A sentence with neither stops and the manager rewrites it. The manager signs the interpretation before other departments act on it.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A regulatory affairs manager at a European product company. National product rules apply. A checklist does not authorise a product.
Fields: Decision id and rule id, produced by the rule register. A rule with no decision id is not circulated. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the decision log the regulatory team already keeps.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the manager.
unknowns: Which departments must receive which class of rule.
Whether a read receipt is required.
research_questions: Is a read receipt enough, or is a reply required?

already_counted.description: The manager still checks the interpretation.

incremental.description: The manager rewrites a sentence that added a duty.

approvals.approved_version: note version and the decision id it cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is a draft tied to a recorded decision and the send of the signed note. It disappears when the rule has no decision and the manager writes the note from the gazette.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Keep current knowledge of proposed and final rules.

steps.what: Filter the feed to relevant proposed and final rules.
Summarise each rule and name policies it may affect.

loop.input: one rule item and the policy list
loop.check: the summary names only policies on the list
loop.stop: stop when every item has a summary or a reject
loop.why_not_simpler: the rule text is prose, and a keyword list misses a renamed duty

steps.what: Decide the impact and record current knowledge.

tasks.design: A filtered feed in {DOCS} shows proposed and final rules from the sources the manager named. Each summary may name only a policy already on the list. The regulatory affairs manager decides the impact, including a decision of no change. An item with no decision stays open. The feed does not edit a policy.
tasks.previous_blocker: Gazettes were skimmed when someone had time, so a final rule arrived as a surprise.
tasks.enabler_now: A filtered feed can put each item in a queue with a summary for a decision.
tasks.still_hard: A rule from a source the filter does not include, and a summary that names the wrong policy.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can tell a wording change that matters from one that does not.

ambition.what: Each proposed or final rule on the feed gets a recorded decision in the week it appears, including a decision that nothing changes.

tasks.altitude: The queue is current. The decision on each rule stays with the manager. Knowledge is the decision log, not the unread feed.

reach.task: Watch a rule feed and record an owner decision on each item.
reach.learn: The feed is the same pattern. The product impact is decided here.

evidence.claim: A filtered feed can queue a rule and a summary can name policies already listed. The owner still decides.
The job digest's rule-change watch stops when every item has a decision. A summary that cites a policy not on the list is rejected. No policy is edited by the feed.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A regulatory affairs manager at a European product company. National product rules apply. A checklist does not authorise a product.

Fields: Source id, rule id, and policy id, produced by the source list and the policy register. An item from an unknown source is not summarised. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the official sources the manager has already named before adding a new feed.
unknowns: Which official sources this product range must watch.
How fast a final rule must be decided.
research_questions: Which sources has the manager already named?
What share of items are decided as no change?

already_counted.description: The manager still decides each item.

incremental.description: The manager corrects a summary that named a policy not on the list.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the filter and the summary. It shrinks when a source is missing and the manager reads the gazette. The decision time remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write regulatory affairs policies and procedures.

steps.what: Open the current policy and the decided rule.
Draft the procedure from that decided rule only.

loop.input: the current policy and the decided rule
loop.check: every new sentence cites the decided rule
loop.stop: stop when a sentence cites nothing
loop.why_not_simpler: procedure text is prose, and a fixed clause would invent a duty

steps.what: Formulate the policy and approve the procedure text.

tasks.design: The current procedure and the decided rule are opened in {DOCS}. A draft may cite only that rule. The regulatory affairs manager formulates the policy and approves the text. Publishing uses the signed version. A sentence with no rule is not published.
tasks.previous_blocker: Procedures were edited in personal copies, so two departments followed two versions.
tasks.enabler_now: A decided rule and the current version can be the only inputs to a draft.
tasks.still_hard: A duty the decided rule does not contain, and a local practice that contradicts it.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can refuse a tidy sentence that adds a duty the rule does not state.
tasks.altitude: Policy text changes only when the manager signs it. The draft cannot add a duty. Publishing is the signed version alone.

reach.task: Publish a procedure only after the owner signs the exact version.
reach.learn: The version rule is the same. The regulatory text is written here.

evidence.claim: A draft procedure can be held to sentences that cite a decided rule. Publishing still needs a signature.

A drafted sentence may cite only a rule or a figure already in the file. A sentence with neither stops and the manager rewrites it. EU GDPR article 22 is not avoided by calling a policy change a document update. The manager signs the text.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A regulatory affairs manager at a European product company. National product rules apply. A checklist does not authorise a product.

Fields: Policy id, version, and decided rule id, produced by the policy register. A draft with no rule id is not published. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the policy register the company already keeps.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the manager.
A drafted sentence may cite only a rule or a figure already in the file. A sentence with neither stops and the manager rewrites it.
unknowns: Who else must approve a policy before it binds a plant.
Which languages the procedure must be published in.
research_questions: Which policies have more than one live version today?
What share of edits add a duty rather than restate a rule?

already_counted.description: The manager still approves the policy text.

incremental.description: The manager rewrites a sentence that cited no rule.

approvals.approved_version: policy version and the rule id each new sentence cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is a cited draft and the publish of a signed version. It disappears when there is no decided rule and the manager writes the procedure from scratch.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List documents required by domestic and international regulations.
Direct the documentation effort and close the gaps.
Record compliance status against those standards.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} list shows documents required for each market the manager has named. The regulatory affairs manager directs which gaps to close and records the status. A market with no list is not marked compliant. Standards are not judged complete by the presence of a file name.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each market's document list lived with a different person, so a gap appeared at renewal.
tasks.enabler_now: Named markets can share one list of required documents.
tasks.still_hard: A standard that asks for content, not just a document title, and a market not yet named.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can tell a file that exists from a file that meets the standard.
tasks.altitude: The list is shared. The direction of the work and the status stay with the manager. A file name is not a pass.

reach.task: Track a required document and leave the adequacy judgement to the owner.
reach.learn: The list can be shared. Adequacy is still judged here.

evidence.claim: A register can list required documents by market. It cannot decide that a document meets the standard.
Marking a market compliant is the manager's status note. A missing market list stops the mark. No automated compliance certificate is produced.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A regulatory affairs manager at a European product company. National product rules apply. A checklist does not authorise a product.
Fields: Market id and required document id, produced by the market list. A market with no list is left open. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the document register the regulatory team already keeps.
unknowns: Which markets are in scope this year.
Which standards are contractual rather than legal.
research_questions: Which markets have a maintained document list?
How often is a present document still found inadequate?

already_counted.description: The manager still directs the gaps.

incremental.description: The manager adds a document type when a market is added.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the document list for markets already named. It disappears when a market has no list and the manager builds it. The direction of the work remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Rule changes can be summarised for a decision. The manager still decides the impact, still writes policy, and still checks that another department has read a rule correctly.
reach: Compliance managers watch a rule feed and record an owner's decision on each item.
Chief sustainability officers read a policy against a stated goal, and this job learns the goal does not edit the policy.
skills_to_grow: Record a decision on every new rule, including a decision that it changes nothing.
Stop a policy sentence that cites no rule already in the file.
role.ambitious_version: Each proposed rule gets a recorded decision in the week it appears, and the policy text still changes only when the manager signs it.
